name: Berumbur (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Berumbur (a yellow ear of wheat between stars on blue).
history: The hoisted flag is divided yellow and blue with the arms at the centre; the arms were officially granted by the Regierungspräsident in Aurich in July 1961.

features.role: Berumbur arms — ear of wheat and stars on blue
